## About This Book

This book was edited…

  * In the [MED CX](http://www.med-editor.com/indexus.html) text editor on Windows XP.

  * Using [Docbook](http://docbook.sourceforge.net/) Version 5.0 namepsace aware stylesheets.

  * Processed with…

    * [xsltproc](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Libxml2) to produce the XHTML version and…

  * And is best viewed in…

    * Mozilla [Firefox](http://www.mozilla.com/) or [Opera](http://www.opera.com/) for the XHTML version
